title: State import confirmation
description: Review the selected filename, size, Employee, and Unit counts before atomically replacing the current state.

title: Invalid state recovery
description: Reject partial, arbitrary, or malformed JSON without changing data and offer an immediate file re-selection action.

title: Direct state Export
description: Download the complete validated application state directly from the sidebar without an intermediate dialog.

title: Database recovery confirmation
description: Recover from an unavailable or corrupt local database by confirming a timestamped backup and a clean current-schema replacement.

title: Dark theme dialog
description: Use the expanded sidebar theme dialog to choose Light, Dark, or System appearance.

title: Light shell and expanded navigation
description: Inspect the light interface with expanded module labels and locally accessible actions.

title: Six-language selector
description: Choose among all six bundled UN-language catalogs in a compact modal selector.

title: Arabic RTL interface
description: Inspect the mirrored Arabic shell and six-language modal while Editor geometry remains direction-stable.

title: Team hierarchy and roster
description: Browse the edge-aligned hierarchy, selected path, searchable roster count, and one contiguous direct and descendant Employee list with tags and row actions.

title: Create a manual Team
description: Create a root Team with manual membership and configure its identity and structure.

title: Configure a Live Team
description: Build dynamic membership from Employee birthday, position, tags, and source Team rules.

title: Edit Team assignments
description: Edit a Team, select its boss, and manage Employee positions and membership assignments.

title: Employee catalog
description: Search the complete Employee catalog and use tag, edit, delete, contact, and Team context actions.

title: Compound Employee filters
description: Compose ordered Team, Tag, position, gender, complete birthday, custom-field, and text criteria with visible match counts.

title: Employee model
description: Inspect built-in Employee, Unit, and Tag tokens together with the configured custom Value and Template fields.

title: Custom Value field
description: Configure a named typed Employee value, required behavior, and stable options that appear in forms, filters, imports, and output.

title: Custom Template field
description: Compose a derived Employee value from token suggestions and choose local MD5 or SHA-256 hashing.

title: Custom Employee filter
description: Filter the Employee catalog by computed or stored custom values, including the explicit Not filled choice.

title: Tag catalog
description: Search the centralized Tag catalog and inspect global color, Employee usage, and dated-assignment counts.

title: Tag catalog editor
description: Rename a Tag in a focused modal without mixing identity changes with color controls.

title: Quick Tag color
description: Open the row-level color action to choose a preset, use the full palette, enter an exact typed value, or reset the Tag color.

title: Employees with a Tag
description: Inspect every Employee carrying a Tag in a virtualized full-card list with the ordinary Tag, Edit, and Delete actions.

title: Employee profile and assignments
description: Edit identity, contact, segmented gender, a compound Day/Month/Year birthday with an unknown-year choice, embedded avatar, draft tags, Team membership, boss state, and positions.

title: Tag date calendar
description: Apply or clear one exact date for an Employee tag through the localized calendar popover.

title: Employee Team assignments
description: Inspect the lower Employee form with Team membership, boss state, and per-Team positions.

title: Local avatar crop
description: Crop and zoom a local PNG, JPEG, WebP, or pasted image before embedding a 512 by 512 result with a local PNG fallback.

title: Visual organization Editor
description: Arrange opaque Unit cards with complete wrapping Tag footers on the adaptive snap grid, including bounded edge-pan, hierarchy lines, zoom, history, and normal-weight layout controls.

title: Editor View selector
description: Switch between the system Units structure and independent planning Views after pasting a copied Unit group across View boundaries.

title: Create or copy a View
description: Create a blank planning canvas or copy any existing View with remapped Unit identity and isolated history.

title: Isolated organization scenario
description: Edit the Unit hierarchy, assignments, rules, and geometry inside a custom View without changing the system Units structure.

title: Rename and delete a View
description: Rename or deliberately delete a custom View while the protected system Units View remains immutable.

title: Employee field mapping
description: Inspect the richest bounded JSON record and map source paths left-to-right into Employee fields, Tags, and optional Team assignments.

title: Editor search
description: Reveal the left-expanding search field, locate Units and Employees without leaving the canvas, and clear the query when Search closes.

title: Employee duplicate resolution
description: Resolve normalized identity-tuple matches in bulk or override individual Employees before one atomic import.

title: Unit context commands
description: Open Unit commands for editing, adding hierarchy, collapse and expand, copy, and local export.

title: Bulk Employee commands
description: Select multiple Employee rows and apply shared boss, tag, edit, copy, or delete actions.

title: Editor image export
description: Prepare a local hierarchy PNG whose Unit cards, centered Employee rows, complete wrapping colored tags, localized boss marker, and connections follow the live canvas without membership-type labels or a secondary viewer.

title: Editor text template export
description: Build a text representation from Employee and Unit tokens with a live preview.

title: Editor structured JSON export
description: Export the selected Unit or subtree through the shared sortable JSON list with scalar, Unit, and Tag rows in the exact output order.

title: Editor image detail settings
description: Configure PNG title, font, spacing, icon-only alignment, localized boss label, and Employee card content without avatar-data template tokens.

title: Organization Analytics
description: Review average age and deterministic age extremes alongside sortable birth-year, position, birthday, and name distributions.

title: Complete Analytics groups
description: Scroll the unified Analytics surface to inspect birth-year and name distributions in bounded groups.

title: Analytics drill-down
description: Open a distribution value to inspect matching Employee cards and their normal actions.

title: Employee Calendar
description: Navigate locale-correct weeks with weekend tones, birthdays, compact dated-tag counts, conditional Today navigation, and a strong current-day state.

title: Calendar day details
description: Open a date to inspect Birthdays first and then one interactive heading plus complete Employee-card list for every dated Tag.

title: Dated-tag event history
description: Open a Tag from the horizontal header rail to inspect heading-free current and future events plus conditional past events as complete Employee cards with actions.

title: Template Data Download
description: Configure a separator-based template, row mode, inline token syntax, live preview, copy, and local download.

title: Template token suggestions
description: Discover the @ shortcut from Format help, filter localized token suggestions, and insert stable brace syntax at the caret.

title: Download source selection
description: Choose a system or custom View, select its assigned Employees from Units or the catalog, inspect the resulting set, then continue from the shared header.

title: JSON Unit and Tag exclusions

title: JSON Download preview
description: Inspect the lower field list and formatted JSON structure before copying or downloading the local file.
